summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of HM Geomatics site. All 12 backend pytest cases pass (health, enquiry CRUD with validation, admin auth, list/delete with token + 404/401 paths, no _id leak, sort desc). All frontend flows verified end-to-end: Home loads with hero/3D canvas/quote/6 services/about/director/contact/footer, sticky nav adds 'is-sticky' on scroll, nav links scroll, enquiry form validation + success submission + form clear, Admin login wrong/correct, dashboard list shows formatted date/name/email/subject/message, refresh/delete (with confirm dialog auto-accept)/sign out all work.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/enquiries returns 200 (not 201) on create — acceptable but 201 would be more idiomatic.
Admin token == ADMIN_PASSWORD plaintext (no JWT/expiry). Acceptable for this lightweight admin page; consider hashing/expiring tokens if scope grows.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handler in future.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed enquiries during tests; all cleaned up via test_zz_cleanup_test_data and inline delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_hmgeomatics_api.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Admin uses x-admin-token header; token value equals ADMIN_PASSWORD plain (hmgeomatics2026). Admin delete UI uses window.confirm — handle with page.on('dialog', d.accept()). 3D canvas renders OK (count=1).
